proof: Let T be paper material area, H the heptagon union area, O its double-layer white overlap, and S=1 its gray single-layer area. A single fold creates at most2 layers.
T=S+2O and H=S+O. Given T=(3/2)H, subtracting yields O=S=1, then H=2 and T=3. Equivalently S=2H-T.
The white overlap, all3 gray single-layer components, original crease and diagram-not-to-scale text are essential semantics. No diagram coordinate area is a numerical given.
